about: How tools/pack.py builds Mean Streets of Gadgetzan 2016 (docs/packs/format.md, 'Build recipes'): on One Night in Karazhan (base), so on Whispers of the Old Gods, The League of Explorers, The Grand Tournament, Blackrock Mountain, Goblins vs Gnomes, Naxxramas and Classic: their cards, patches, scripts, fonts, texts and pictures by reference, without Classic's hand-tuned text layout (skip); then the 132 cards of Mean Streets of Gadgetzan and their tokens as the release build 15590 has them (patch 7.0.0.15590 of 2016-11-29, two days before the release; data/msg_cards.json, tools/extract_cards.py --set msg) with the names and texts of that build for every card of the chain (cards.texts.json, written by the same tool), and this pack's own patch (cards.patch.json: the scripts of scripts/msg.lua, the keywords, the older cards that changed by then).
